newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Seafresh says NZD/yen volatility hurting.
newsitem.headline: Seafresh says NZD/yen volatility hurting.

text.p: Seafresh Ltd said on Thursday the continuing volatility of the New Zealand dollar, particularly with respect to the Japanese yen, was having a negative impact on the fishing company's position.
Earlier, Seafresh posted a NZ$1.18 million net profit for the six months to March 31 1997, which included a $1.5 million abnormal gain attributable to allocation of new quota.
The company said the half-year period produced an operational profit before tax of $185,745, which compared favourably with a $347,245 loss for the same period last year.
However, it said the catches from the summer squid operations had fallen below expectation.
"The directors look forward to the commencement of the winter fishing season. Prospects for good catches have been indicated by early activity," Seafresh said.
